_help: SPYR+ settings. gate: where SPYR+ is switched on (web stays free until you flip it). launch: the date free weeks start from for accounts made before launch. freeDays: length of the free week. plus: what needs SPYR+ once the free week is over. comp: player ids that get SPYR+ free (find an id in Supabase: select key, value->>'name' from kv where key like 'rt1:p:%'; the id is the part after rt1:p:).
